name: oauth2-upstream-authentication
description:
Authenticates outbound requests to an upstream backend using OAuth2. The gateway
exchanges credentials for a short-lived access token at a configured token endpoint
and injects it as an Authorization: Bearer header. Tokens are cached and refreshed
automatically ahead of expiry. The grant used is selected via grantType:
client_credentials (RFC 6749 4.4, the standard machine-to-machine grant) or
password (RFC 6749 4.3, Resource Owner Password Credentials, for legacy identity
providers). Client authentication always uses client_secret_basic.
